3ddb5601ebc4ec9e.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:  

As a Pre-Sales Senior Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions that demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services, helping organizations within the UK Defence and Intelligence community overcome critical Earth observation and geospatial challenges. You will act as a trusted advisor and value driver to prospective customers while working closely with product, engineering, and sales teams across Planet to champion customer needs. The ideal candidate, thrives in client-facing environments and has deep familiarity working within the UK Defence and Intelligence sector.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the UK. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week. Up to 25% travel (domestic and international).

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with technical, operational, and executive leadership within customer accounts.
  • Lead the technical architecture and end-to-end design of solutions tailored to complex mission and operational requirements.
  • Deliver technical solution demonstrations and presentations, highlighting Planet’s capabilities and value to UK Government and Defence bodies.
  • Facilitate technical workshops for operators and technical stakeholders.
  • Lead the technical responses for tenders, RFIs/RFPs, and unsolicited proposals.
  • Work closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to represent customer feedback and inform product roadmap priorities.
  • Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.
  • Represent the needs of Planet's Defence and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback. 
  • Mentor junior team members and lead internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of experience supporting the UK Defence and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Have the ability to obtain and maintain a UK Security Clearance (SC or DV).
  • Deep domain knowledge in Earth Observation, GIS, Remote Sensing, IMINT, and ISR mission workflows.
  • Working experience with ArcGIS, QGIS, SocetGXP, GDAL, Python, and other geospatial software packages and programming languages.
  • Expertise in geospatial system architectures, cloud environments/secure deployments, API integrations, and complex data pipelines.
  • Track record translating customer mission challenges into scalable technical architectures and clear, high-impact demonstrations.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%, including internationally.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Active DV (Developed Vetting) clearance.
  • Direct background as an imagery/geospatial intelligence analyst (IMINT/GEOINT) or operational user within UK MoD or allied intelligence services.
  • Skilled in translating complex customer requirements into compelling, narrative-driven solutions, paired with a natural ability to command the room with senior defence executives, military leaders, and procurement authorities.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Export Control Requirements:

Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Benefits While Working at Planet:

These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.

  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off 
  • Employee Wellness Program 
  • Home Office Reimbursement
  • Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement
  • Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Equity 
  • Volunteering Paid Time Off

Headquarters: 

Overview
We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.
***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***
Responsibilities
• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning real, paid mechanical CAD work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.
• Define each task precisely, including the files, systems and environment it runs on, so an AI agent can attempt it without ambiguity or hidden assumptions.
• Write a working reference solution using scripted CAD, such as FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, that rebuilds parametric parts correctly after parameters change.
• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.
• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.
• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, documenting the design intent, tools, data and rules used so others can reproduce and validate your work.
Skills/Experience
• 3+ years designing real mechanical parts that were manufactured or shipped, doing the hands-on work yourself (not only studying, selling, managing or teaching it)
• Hands-on CAD work within the last 3 years, with the ability to name the systems, tools, data and rules you used
• Builds or modifies designs through scripts (FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, OpenSCAD, Onshape FeatureScript), not only through GUI work
• Reads engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T, and can explain how a design mistake would be caught
• Technical fluency with Python or another language and the command line, plus files such as CSV/JSON, APIs or databases
• Availability to start around early November 2026 and take on tasks on a flexible, task-based schedule
Nice-to-have
• Parametric design-intent experience
• Open-source hardware contributions or projects
• Docker and Git experience
• Experience writing automated tests
• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows
Process
• Task-based vetting: you complete a vetting task instead of an interview
• Paid per task, with each task taking about 60-75 minutes to solve
• Flexible, task-based work cadence, with an expected start around early November 2026

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cad-scripting-expert

Headquarters: Americas Remote

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Caitlin, Senior Manager, Technical Support at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an Email Deliverability Specialist to join our deliverability program within Technical Support. You'll help customers reach the inbox by diagnosing sending issues, advising on best practices, and guiding senders through an email ecosystem that keeps changing.

You'll be one of several deliverability experts on a team that shares knowledge across Technical Support, so your work reaches well beyond your own queue. You'll partner with Customer Success, Technical Support, and Engineering: taking customer calls, equipping CSMs for customer conversations, working through complex technical cases alongside Engineering, and turning what you see in tickets into documentation, training, and better processes.

You'll thrive here if you think about the health of the whole program, enjoy improving how work gets done, and are equally comfortable digging into a detailed case and having a direct conversation with a customer about acceptable use.

What we value

Empathy and curiosity: You approach every customer with patience and a desire to dig deeper, especially when a conversation gets uncomfortable.

Clarity: You explain complex technical concepts simply and help others do the same.

Collaboration: You build strong partnerships across Support, Customer Success, and Engineering, and you treat customer outcomes as a shared goal.

Thinking at scale: You look at how we do things today and see what could work better for the whole organization, then you help make it happen.

Continuous learning: You stay ahead of evolving standards and see change as a chance to improve how we work.

What you'll do

• Act as a trusted deliverability advisor to customers, handling complex cases through to full resolution and leading customer calls when a conversation needs it

• Audit sender setup and monitor reputation across IPs and domains, using authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and BIMI, DNS configuration, and provider tools like Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, and Microsoft SNDS to diagnose blocklists, spam traps, and engagement drops

• Work through highly technical issues with Engineering, taking ownership of the investigation first and sharing trends from customer cases with Product and Engineering

• Identify acceptable use policy violations and spam complaints, hold clear and direct conversations with customers about compliance, and keep up with evolving standards (Gmail and Yahoo sender requirements, CAN-SPAM, GDPR)

• Equip CSMs and Technical Support with the knowledge to handle deliverability conversations, through coaching, documentation, and training

• Improve processes, tools, and one-to-many resources, such as help content, Academy course and proactive customer guidance, so deliverability support scales across the organization

What we're looking for

• 2-4 years of experience in email deliverability at a mid-size or large ESP, B2B SaaS company, or marketing automation platform, with exposure to deliverability at scale

• Deep understanding of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI) and infrastructure (SMTP, MTAs, DNS), with the technical comfort to work through complex issues with Engineering

• Proficiency with provider data feeds (Google Postmaster Tools, Yahoo Sender Hub, Microsoft SNDS) and third-party deliverability monitoring tools like Everest, MXToolbox, or similar, and the analytical skill to turn bounce, engagement, and blocklist data into clear recommendations

• Working knowledge of email compliance and acceptable use standards, and comfort having direct conversations with customers who are sending outside of them

• Experience building or improving processes, documentation, or training that help a support or deliverability team scale

• Excellent written and verbal communication, including comfort leading customer calls and simplifying technical concepts for any audience

• Located in the United States or Canada

• Bonus: participation in deliverability communities (M3AAWG, ESPC, or similar) and experience partnering with Customer Success teams

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $102,000 - $110,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

• 30-minute video call with a Recruiter

• 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager

• 60 minute Case Study Review call with Cross-Functional Partners

• 30 minute video call with potential Team Member

• 30 minute final video call with Senior Leadership

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-email-deliverability-specialist

Requirements - 2–4 years of full-stack development experience. - Strong experience with React, Node.js, TypeScript and REST APIs. - Hands-on experience deploying and supporting applications on AWS. - Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL and NoSQL databases. - Strong practical experience with Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI development tools. - Ability to instruct AI tools clearly and validate their output. - Understanding of authentication, asynchronous workflows and secure API development. - Experience with Git, automated testing, Docker and CI/CD. - Ability to work independently and communicate clearly. Good to Have - Experience building multi-tenant SaaS products. - Familiarity with Redis, ClickHouse or event-driven systems. - Experience with agentic development workflows or AI automations. - Exposure to browser or mobile SDK development. To Apply Please share your résumé, notice period and compensation expectations, along with: - A brief description of a production system you developed on AWS. - An example of how you used AI tools for a meaningful development task.

Financial Analyst II

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

As a Financial Analyst II at ICON, you will play a significant role in supporting advanced financial planning, analysis, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Do

Your role will involve delivering finance and financial management work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Conducting detailed financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business unit performance and strategic planning.
• Developing and maintaining complex financial models to evaluate business scenarios and support decision-making processes.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to monitor and report on key financial and operational metrics.
• Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
• Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices in financial analysis and reporting.

Your Profile

You will bring relevant finance and financial management experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.

Required Qualifications And Experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in financial analysis or related roles, with a strong understanding of financial principles and practices.
• Advanced proficiency in financial modeling and analytical tools, such as Excel, with experience in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) being a plus.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
• Willingness to travel as required (approximately 5%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

• Various annual leave entitlements
• A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
• Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
• Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
• Life assurance
• Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here

Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

3d0e22e3d4c92be0.description: We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to join our team in Karnataka. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data analysis and reporting, with a focus on utilizing Power BI and the Power Platform to deliver actionable insights. As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing complex data sets, creating reports, and presenting findings to stakeholders. You will work closely with various departments to understand their data needs and provide solutions that enhance decision-making processes. Key responsibilities include developing and maintaining dashboards, performing data validation, and ensuring data integrity. You will also be involved in KPI reporting and will need to manage stakeholder expectations effectively. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, proficiency in Power BI, and experience with the Power Platform. Excellent communication skills are essential for collaborating with team members and presenting data-driven insights. If you are passionate about data and have a keen eye for detail, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
